name: Incline Bench Press
common_faults: angle too steep (becomes shoulder press at >45°)
elbows flared too wide increasing shoulder impingement risk

substitutions.note: flat angle; more sternal pec emphasis
dumbbell version; greater ROM, less load ceiling

contraindications: shoulder impingement provoked by incline pressing
resistance_profile: hardest off the chest; clavicular pec and anterior delt are the primary movers

provenance.notes: Upper pec emphasis depends on angle (30–45° optimal range). Excessive incline shifts load primarily to anterior deltoid. SFR heuristic.
